name: Acute Coronary Syndrome (STEMI Risk)
clinical_summary: High probability of myocardial ischemia requiring immediate ECG and reperfusion evaluation.

name: Acute Ischemic Stroke / TIA
clinical_summary: Time-critical neurological deficit requiring immediate non-contrast head CT and stroke activation.

name: Anaphylaxis (Airway Compromise)
clinical_summary: Life-threatening systemic hypersensitivity with upper airway edema risk.

name: Bacterial Meningitis
clinical_summary: Acute CNS infection indicated by fever and meningeal irritation requiring urgent empiric antibiotics.

name: Sepsis / Systemic Infection
clinical_summary: Suspected systemic infection with hemodynamic or mental status compromise.

name: Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA)
clinical_summary: Acute metabolic decompensation with hyperglycemia and ketosis risk.

name: Hypertensive Crisis
clinical_summary: Severely elevated blood pressure with potential end-organ neurological symptoms.

name: Severe Asthma Exacerbation
clinical_summary: Acute bronchospasm causing significant respiratory distress and hypoxia risk.

name: Acute Appendicitis
clinical_summary: Focal right lower quadrant peritoneal irritation requiring surgical consult and imaging.

name: Community-Acquired Pneumonia
clinical_summary: Lower respiratory tract bacterial infection requiring chest imaging and antibiotic therapy.

name: Acute Gastroenteritis (Dehydration Risk)
clinical_summary: Gastrointestinal fluid loss requiring hydration assessment and electrolyte check.

name: Classic Migraine Attack
clinical_summary: Primary neurovascular headache without red-flag meningeal or focal signs.

name: Viral Upper Respiratory Infection
clinical_summary: Self-limiting viral rhinitis/pharyngitis suitable for routine clinic care.
